% ============================================================
% style.tex - Shared preamble, macros and layout definitions
% Adapted from DSE-latex/Maths for HKTA THMSS F.1 First Test
% ============================================================

\usepackage[a4paper,top=25mm,bottom=22mm,left=25mm,right=22mm,headsep=5mm,footskip=0mm]{geometry}
\usepackage{tikz}
\usetikzlibrary{calc}
\usepackage{array}
\usepackage{amsmath,amssymb}
\usepackage{graphicx}
\usepackage{enumitem}
\usepackage{fancyhdr}
\usepackage{helvet}
\usepackage{mathptmx}  % Times New Roman for text and math
\usepackage{pgfcore}
\usepackage{atbegshi}  % Better page shipout control than everypage
\usepackage{etoolbox}    % \ifstrempty for subparts empty-stem check

% Default font is Times New Roman (will be overridden for cover page)

% ---- Colours ----
\definecolor{stripeblack}{gray}{0.0}
\definecolor{rulegray}{gray}{0.6}

% ---- Centralised customisation settings ----
% All paper-specific text and metadata live in config.tex.
\input{config}

% ------------------------------------------------------------
% Top-left slanted (parallelogram) label + thin left vertical rule
% The strip is WHITE with a thin black border; text is black.
% ------------------------------------------------------------
\newcommand{\DrawCornerStrip}{%
  \begin{tikzpicture}[remember picture,overlay]
    % Slanted black line
    \draw[black,line width=1.1mm]
      ([xshift=57mm,yshift=-4mm]current page.north west) --
      ([xshift=4mm,yshift=-57mm]current page.north west);

    % Black text on the slanted strip
    \node[black,font=\bfseries\small,anchor=west]
      at ([xshift=8mm,yshift=-25mm]current page.north west)
      {\begin{tabular}{@{}l@{}}\PaperCode\\\PaperSubjLine \vspace{2mm} \\  \textmd{\PaperType}\end{tabular}};
  \end{tikzpicture}%
}

% ------------------------------------------------------------
% Answer space: n ruled lines. Lines span the full text width
% (the geometry package provides the 5mm right padding inside
% the border).
% ------------------------------------------------------------
\newlength{\AnswerLineWidth}
\AtBeginDocument{\setlength{\AnswerLineWidth}{\linewidth}}
\newcommand{\answerlines}[1]{%
  \par\vspace{2mm}
  \foreach \i in {1,...,#1}{%
    \vspace{7mm}\noindent\rule{\AnswerLineWidth}{0.2pt}\par
  }%
}

% ------------------------------------------------------------
% \question{N}{M}: sets the current question number and mark value,
% then writes the inline header "N. " and stores M in the deferred
% marks slot. The stem (if any) follows inline.
% ------------------------------------------------------------
\newlength{\QuestionTextIndent}

\newcommand{\question}[2]{%
  \par\vspace{5mm}%
  \noindent
  \settowidth{\QuestionTextIndent}{\textbf{#1.}\hspace{0.8em}}%
  \textbf{#1.}\hspace{0.5em}\ignorespaces
  \gdef\CurrentQuestionNumber{#1}%
  \gdef\CurrentQuestionMarks{(#2 marks)}%
}

% Stash for the current question's number (used by \subparts) and
% marks (used by \finishquestion / end of \subparts).
\makeatletter
\gdef\CurrentQuestionNumber{}%
\gdef\CurrentQuestionMarks{}%
\makeatother

% ------------------------------------------------------------
% \subparts: enumerate-style block with labels (a), (b), ...
%
% Usage (call \question{N}{M} first to set the number and marks):
%
%   \begin{subparts}                % first \item takes the stem position
%     \item ...
%     \item ...
%   \end{subparts}
%
%   \begin{subparts}{stem}           % explicit stem, then \items follow
%     \item ...
%   \end{subparts}
%
% Layout produced:
%   N. <first item>          (no stem)
%      (a) <item 1>
%      (b) <item 2>
%                       (M marks)
%
%   N. <stem text>           (explicit stem)
%      (a) <item 1>
%      ...
%                       (M marks)
%
% The leading "N. " is printed by \question; \subparts only emits the
% item list and the trailing marks badge.
% ------------------------------------------------------------
\newif\ifSubpartMarksPending
\global\SubpartMarksPendingfalse
\newif\ifSubpartFirstItem
\global\SubpartFirstItemfalse
\newcounter{enumSub}
\newcounter{enumSubii}
\let\QuestionPaperOriginalItem\item

\makeatletter
\newenvironment{subparts}{%
  \global\SubpartMarksPendingtrue
  \global\SubpartFirstItemtrue
  \setcounter{enumSub}{0}%
  \@ifnextchar\bgroup
    {\subparts@withstem}
    {\subparts@nosterm}%
}{%
  \subparts@end%
}

\newcommand{\subparts@nosterm}{%
  \bgroup
  \par\vspace{3pt}%
  \def\item{%
    \ifnum\value{enumSub}>0\par\vspace{4pt}\fi
    \par\noindent\hspace*{\QuestionTextIndent}%
    \stepcounter{enumSub}\makebox[1.5em][l]{(\alph{enumSub})}%
    \hangindent=\dimexpr\QuestionTextIndent+1.5em\relax\hangafter=1\relax
  }%
}

\newcommand{\subparts@withstem}[1]{%
  \bgroup
  \global\SubpartFirstItemfalse
  \par\noindent#1\par\vspace{2pt}%
  \def\item{%
    \ifnum\value{enumSub}>0\par\vspace{4pt}\fi
    \par\noindent\hspace*{\QuestionTextIndent}%
    \stepcounter{enumSub}\makebox[1.5em][l]{(\alph{enumSub})}%
    \hangindent=\dimexpr\QuestionTextIndent+1.5em\relax\hangafter=1\relax
  }%
}

\newcommand{\subparts@end}{%
  \egroup
  \ifSubpartMarksPending
    \global\SubpartMarksPendingfalse
    \par\hfill\textnormal{\CurrentQuestionMarks}\par
  \fi
  \par\vspace{2pt}%
  \gdef\CurrentQuestionMarks{}%
  \ignorespacesafterend
}
\makeatother

\newenvironment{subpartsii}[1][1]{%
  \let\item\QuestionPaperOriginalItem
  \begin{enumerate}[
    label=(\roman*),
    start=#1,
    leftmargin=\dimexpr\QuestionTextIndent+3.5em\relax,
    labelwidth=1.5em,
    labelsep=.5em,
    topsep=4pt,
    itemsep=4pt,
    parsep=0pt
  ]%
}{%
  \end{enumerate}%
}

% ------------------------------------------------------------
% \finishquestion: explicitly drop the deferred marks badge at the
% current position (e.g. mid-question for layout reasons). Also
% clears the auto-drop flag so the badge is not printed again at
% the end of the enclosing subparts block.
% ------------------------------------------------------------
\newcommand{\finishquestion}{%
  \par\ifx\CurrentQuestionMarks\@empty\else
    \global\SubpartMarksPendingfalse
    \hfill\textnormal{\CurrentQuestionMarks}\par
    \gdef\CurrentQuestionMarks{}%
  \fi
}

% ------------------------------------------------------------
% Per-item marks: pushed to the right margin at the end of an item
% ------------------------------------------------------------
\newcommand{\qmarks}[1]{\nobreak\hfill\textnormal{(#1 marks)}}

% ------------------------------------------------------------
% Section header
% ------------------------------------------------------------
\newcommand{\sectionheader}[1]{%
  \vspace*{0mm}
  \noindent\textbf{Section #1}\par
  \vspace{1mm}
}

% ------------------------------------------------------------
% Page footer with page number and margin frame
% ------------------------------------------------------------
\pagestyle{fancy}
\fancyhf{}
\renewcommand{\headrulewidth}{0pt}
\fancyfoot[C]{\hspace*{3.5mm}\fontsize{12pt}{12pt}\selectfont\thepage}
\fancyfoot[L]{\hspace*{3.5em}\fontsize{8pt}{9pt}\selectfont \PaperFooterCode}
\fancyheadoffset[L]{22mm}
\fancyfootoffset[L]{22mm}

% Count physical sheets independently of \value{page}, because the
% titlepage environment resets the page counter to 1 (so the cover and the
% first content page both report page=1). Sheet 1 = cover, sheet 2+ = content.
\newcounter{physsheet}
\setcounter{physsheet}{0}
\AtBeginShipout{%
  \stepcounter{physsheet}%
  \ifnum\value{physsheet}>1\relax
    \AtBeginShipoutUpperLeft{%
      \begin{tikzpicture}[remember picture,overlay]
        % Draw the rectangular frame - on ALL content pages (sheet > 1)
        \draw[black,line width=0.4pt]
          ([xshift=17mm,yshift=-22mm]current page.north west) rectangle
          ([xshift=-17mm,yshift=30mm]current page.south east);
        % "Answers written in the margins will not be marked." notice
        % running just inside the left, right and bottom borders.
        \node[black,font=\fontsize{10pt}{10pt}\selectfont,rotate=90,anchor=center]
          at ([xshift=13mm]current page.west)
          {\MarginNotice};
        \node[black,font=\fontsize{10pt}{10pt}\selectfont,rotate=90,anchor=center]
          at ([xshift=-13mm]current page.east)
          {\MarginNotice};
        \node[black,font=\fontsize{10pt}{10pt}\selectfont,anchor=center]
          at ([xshift=-50mm,yshift=25mm]current page.south)
          {\MarginNotice};
      \end{tikzpicture}%
    }%
  \fi
}

% Cover page style (different margins: left=0mm, right=12mm)
\fancypagestyle{cover}{%
  \fancyhf{}
  \renewcommand{\headrulewidth}{0pt}
  \fancyfoot[C]{\hspace*{6mm}\fontsize{12pt}{12pt}\selectfont\thepage}
  \fancyfoot[L]{\hspace*{5.5em}\fontsize{8pt}{9pt}\selectfont \PaperFooterCode}
  \fancyheadoffset[L]{0mm}
  \fancyfootoffset[L]{0mm}
}

% ============================================================
% marks-table.tex - Question numbers and marks for the cover page
% Set the question range and total in config.tex.
% ============================================================
{\fontsize{10pt}{12pt}\selectfont
\renewcommand{\arraystretch}{\MarksTableRowHeight}
\newcount\MarksTableQuestion
\def\PrintMarksTableRows{%
  \the\MarksTableQuestion & \\ \hline
  \ifnum\MarksTableQuestion<\MarksTableLastQuestion\relax
    \global\advance\MarksTableQuestion by 1
    \expandafter\PrintMarksTableRows
  \fi
}
\MarksTableQuestion=\MarksTableFirstQuestion\relax
\begin{tabular}{|>{\centering\arraybackslash}m{2cm}||>{\centering\arraybackslash}m{2cm}|}
\hline
\textbf{Question No.} & \textbf{Marks} \\
\hline
\PrintMarksTableRows
\hline
\textbf{Total} & \textbf{\MarksTableTotal} \\
\hline
\end{tabular}}
